title: Boardwalk Ady first meeting

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Hello my friend! Won't you join me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello my friend! Won't you join me?

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Indeed! This spot is the best I've found all month. The lampet eels are biting!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed! This spot is the best I've found all month. The lampet eels are biting!

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: For eating? They are not! Indeed, a single bite will likely leave you writhing in agony for three hours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For eating? They are not! Indeed, a single bite will likely leave you writhing in agony for three hours.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: You are wondering why we would be catching such fish? To use it as bait to catch something better! Just like life. We must take misfortune and remake it into fortune.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are wondering why we would be catching such fish? To use it as bait to catch something better! Just like life. We must take misfortune and remake it into fortune.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: This is a joke, yes? Like the story of the underwater boat made of fruit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is a joke, yes? Like the story of the underwater boat made of fruit.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Well, even if you don't like my jokes, you are welcome to join me for some fishing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, even if you don't like my jokes, you are welcome to join me for some fishing.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: I have more good jokes! I will share them if you join me for fishing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have more good jokes! I will share them if you join me for fishing.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Come back and see me when you've caught something. Then we can REALLY talk fish, eh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come back and see me when you've caught something. Then we can REALLY talk fish, eh?

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: Just find a spot and cast a line. Or take a boat and get some real fishing done. But why swim before you can paddle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just find a spot and cast a line. Or take a boat and get some real fishing done. But why swim before you can paddle?

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: A fishing pole of course! Just find some water and cast. Let the fish do all the work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A fishing pole of course! Just find some water and cast. Let the fish do all the work.

nodes.speaker: Boardwalk Ady
nodes.text: I happen to have an extra. It's old and a bit rusty but... better than using your hands!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I happen to have an extra. It's old and a bit rusty but... better than using your hands!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could I get rich selling fish?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could I get rich selling fish?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Could I get rich selling fish?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Could I get rich selling fish?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where do I get a fishing rod?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do I get a fishing rod?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where do I get a fishing rod?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where do I get a fishing rod?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I already have a fishing rod.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I already have a fishing rod.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I already have a fishing rod.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I already have a fishing rod.
